title: Give-and-Go With a Cutter
description: A passer feeds a teammate then cuts hard to the rim, while a second cutter reads the first to fill the space left behind.

content.objective: Cut with purpose off every pass and fill the space a teammate's cut creates.
content.setup: Three players set up at the top and both wings, one ball to start.
instructions: The top player passes to a wing and cuts hard to the basket.
The opposite wing fills toward the top as the cut happens.
If the cutter doesn't receive the ball, they clear through to the opposite corner.
Continue the pattern continuously for two minutes, rotating spots.
coachingPoints: Cut immediately after passing, with no hesitation.
Fill the vacated spot right away to keep spacing correct.
Change speed on the cut to create real separation.
commonMistakes: Standing and watching the pass instead of cutting.
Two players filling the same spot and crowding the floor.
Standing still after a pass instead of moving with purpose.
content.safety: Keep the cutting lanes clear of any stray equipment.
